title: Spawning a package binary from node_modules/.bin
intent: Package scripts are shebang files, not ELF binaries and not JavaScript modules. Running them needs an interpreter shim, a subsystem that is easy to forget and immediately missed.
source: stackblitz-conformance: NodeJS child processes and package binaries (public 'Runtime Test Cases for AI Agents' suite, adapted into our own scenario)

steps.purpose: Install a package that ships a bin

knownLimits: Without an interpreter for shebang scripts, spawn returns ENOENT. The incumbent's equivalent is called jsh; we have no equivalent yet.
